title: Multihazard design of structures
description: Fundamental considerations of wave mechanics; design philosophies; reliability and risk concepts; basics of fluid mechanics; design of structures subjected to blast; elements of seismic design; elements of fire design; flood considerations; advanced analysis in support of structural design.
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: ( CIEN E3125 ) or ( CIEN E4232 ) or CIEN E3125 OR CIEN E4232 ; or instructor's permission.
raw_title_text: CIEN E4235 Multihazard design of structures. 3 points .
